human-mountain.title: Human Mountain
human-mountain.blurb: Good for climbing, giggles, and a parent who needs to lie down.
steps: Lie on your back on the rug. You're a sleeping mountain.
Your kid climbs. Narrate the expedition in a whisper.
At the summit, the mountain rumbles. Repeat.

sleepy-lion.title: Sleepy Lion
sleepy-lion.blurb: Good for sneaking, roaring, and a parent who can play with their eyes shut.
steps: You're a lion asleep on the sofa. Snore loudly.
Your kid sneaks up. If you hear a sound, open one eye.
When they touch your paw, wake up roaring. Swap roles.

story-stones.title: Three-Word Story
story-stones.blurb: Good for the sofa, a tired voice, and a dragon that goes wherever you say.
steps: Take turns adding three words to a story.
Every story starts with "Once, a tiny dragon…".
The last turn has to end it. Then start a new one.

sock-hunt.title: Sock Hunt
sock-hunt.blurb: Good for one room, a drawer of socks, and a kid who loves "warmer, colder".
steps: Hide five rolled-up socks while your kid counts to twenty.
Say "warm" or "cold" as they search.
Swap: now they hide, you hunt.

mirror.title: Mirror, Mirror
mirror.blurb: Good for silly faces, no mess, and a parent who can stand but not run.
steps: Face each other. Your kid moves, you copy, slowly.
Make it harder: faces, then sounds, then silly walks.
Swap who leads every two minutes.

pillow-island.title: Pillow Islands
pillow-island.blurb: Good for balance, a floor full of cushions, and a game that packs away in a minute.
steps: Scatter cushions on the floor. The floor is the sea.
Cross the room without touching the water.
Every round, take one island away.

freeze-dance.title: Freeze Dance
freeze-dance.blurb: Good for one song, a wiggly kid, and a parent with one wild dance left in them.
steps: Put on one song. Dance as wildly as you can.
Whoever is in charge shouts "Freeze!" at any moment.
Anyone who wobbles is in charge next.

animal-race.title: Animal Race
animal-race.blurb: Good for a hallway, loud animals, and a kid who has to run before bed.
steps: Race down the hallway as a crab.
Back as a frog. Then a bear. Then a snake.
The winner picks the next animal.

obstacle.title: Living-Room Obstacle Course
obstacle.blurb: Good for builders, a slow count out loud, and a room you don't mind rearranging.
steps: Build a course: under a chair, over a cushion, around the table.
Time your kid with a slow count out loud.
They change one obstacle, then time you.
